subject: Use modified IQ when broadcasting newly disguised beggars
description: DONE. Savegame_linux2 Profile_002 Savegame_016 replay-013 first diverged at frame 23146 on Soldier104's detectable-list length: Original had 67 entries and Rust 66. Both rebuilt the Beggar list when Soldier104 entered SeekingSeekpoint, adding existing true beggar Civilian40. Later in the same frame PC172 (mapped Rust PC171) completed its beggar-entry transition. The focused eligibility test covers Hard base IQ 15 admitted and 14 rejected, plus camp, seek-substate, and uniqueness gates.
